svg.title: Le VIOLET-ROUGE — planche XXVIII, Répertoire chromatique (1890)
svg.desc: Editable geometric reconstruction of Charles Lacouture's original plate, based on the Getty Research Institute scan, leaf 220. Native vector cells preserve the original arrangement; solid colours are approximate spatial averages of the scanned ink screens, not calibrated pigment measurements. Paper wear and fine lithographic texture are omitted.
svg.metadata: {"source": "https://archive.org/details/gri_33125012875395", "sourceLeaf": 220, "reconstruction": "native SVG paths, editable text; approximate scan-derived colours"}
svg.text: ses diverses nuances combinées avec le noir
N. B. Fermer l’atlas pour soustraire ces planches à la lumière aussitôt qu’on
n’a plus besoin d’en faire usage.
